connection_setup_lead: Before signing in, provide the Hub address and the CA file — the same one the CLI uses via TLS_CA_FILE.
login_error_generic: Could not sign in. Check the token and the connection.
account_logout_confirm: Sign out? The Hub address and certificate stay saved.
account_forget_everything_confirm: This removes the saved credential, Hub address, and certificate from this computer. Continue?
home_empty_active: No active runbooks. Create one to get started.
home_empty_published: No runbooks published in your areas yet.
home_published_search_empty: No published runbook matches the search.
home_delete_confirm: Delete the runbook "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
home_delete_processing_confirm: This runbook is still processing. Delete it anyway?
home_new_raw_log_placeholder:
Paste the terminal session or the commands you ran
A line starting with \@ becomes a command, and the ones after it become its output. With no \@ anywhere, the whole text becomes a paragraph.
home_new_raw_log_hint: Leave blank for a purely visual runbook, with no terminal commands (e.g. steps in a graphical interface).
editor_select_hint: Check the commands that should go into the runbook, then generate the draft.
editor_no_commands_hint: No commands were captured. Generate the draft and write the procedure by hand — ideal for purely visual runbooks.
editor_draft_hint: Review and complete the text below before publishing. The mandatory-review notices mark what needs your attention.
editor_publish_confirm: Publish this runbook? It becomes visible to anyone with access to the area.
editor_create_error: Could not create the runbook on the Hub.
editor_wait_error: The Hub did not prepare the runbook in time.
editor_discard_confirm: Close without publishing? The edited text is not saved.
published_load_error: Could not load the published content.
published_revise_confirm: Publish this revision? It creates a new immutable version and does not change the current one.
published_revise_error: Could not publish the revision. If this version was already revised by someone else, the Hub reports which version is current in the lineage.
markdown_image_notice: Images are reprocessed and scanned before publication.
markdown_image_unsupported: Only PNG or JPEG images are accepted.
offline_title: Could not connect to the Hub
offline_body: The configured Hub did not respond. Check the network and whether the address and certificate in Settings are correct.
editor_enrich_hint: Enriching sends the original text to the Hub to extract the commands and suggest an objective, impacts, and rollback. The runbook joins the queue and comes back editable from the home screen.
editor_enrich_confirm: This sends the original text to the Hub and discards this local draft. The runbook joins the queue; you review and publish it once it turns PENDING. Continue?
editor_enrich_queued: Sent. The runbook is PROCESSING on the Hub — follow it on the home screen. Once it turns PENDING, open it from the table to review and publish.
editor_no_step_error: The runbook needs at least one step. Use the step button in the toolbar to add one with a command, or one with an image as visual evidence. The Hub refuses to publish without it.
editor_step_title_error: Complete the step title after the colon: without the action written there, the Hub does not recognize the line as a step and refuses the whole runbook
